identity: Mournfen's barrows hold the oldest remembered dead of the Throng; the fen keeps rising, bandits loot the barrows and the mirefolk count stolen bones as wages.

quests.title: The Fen Gives Them Back
quests.text: Every morning the Rooting Plague Boars dig up another burial in the {name:blightfields}, which lies {zone_area:blightfields}, and I find myself burying old acquaintances again. Kill eight during the day. Some of the disturbed graves have tally marks beside them; even in Mournfen, I do not suspect the boars of bookkeeping.
quests.lesson: New band, familiar neutral boars; the fen's local problem is seeded.

quests.title: By the Light of Supper
quests.text: Eight Raw Meat, please; I need to render tallow for the vigil candles. Some mourners complain that remembering the departed should not smell quite so much like supper. They still cup their hands around the flame when the draught comes.
quests.lesson: Ordinary loot can be saved before the request is accepted.

quests.title: The Marks in the Reeds
quests.text: Sera Vane has found the same tally marks among the reeds she watches from Mournfen Outpost. Go there and tell her what you saw in the burial rows. I would like to be mistaken about this, but I have had a very long time to recognise a theft.
quests.lesson: Travel to the zone's second hub.

quests.title: Somebody's Grandfather as Wages
quests.text: I watched the Reed Mirefolk in {name:blackreed_enclosure}, {dir_from_giver:blackreed_enclosure}, settle a day's wages with bones from our barrows. Kill eight of them to disrupt the trade, and watch for Reed Crocodiles around the enclosure. They scratch each payment on a reed for {name:reed_counter_silt}; apparently robbing the dead requires excellent records.
quests.lesson: A mirefolk camp with a crocodile minor role; the line's climax is seeded.

quests.title: A Light Can Lie
quests.text: Mourners see the Wandering Wisps over the {name:wispfen}, which lies {zone_area:wispfen}, after dark and think someone has come to guide them home. Put out seven before more people follow them into the water. Go by night; by day you will find Plague Tuskers, whose intentions are at least easy to read.
quests.lesson: A night-only target over swamp ground.

quests.title: Visiting Hours Are Cancelled
quests.text: The Plague Tuskers in the {name:barrowfields}, which lies {zone_area:barrowfields}, now greet daytime mourners with a charge. Kill seven so we can tend the graves without adding hurriedly to them. Watch for Cairn Sun-Dried Husks among the barrows; I have enough names awaiting entry without yours.
quests.lesson: Aggressive boars with a slow undead minor role.

quests.title: Lanterns Belong Above the Mud
quests.text: One by one, the lantern hooks along the barrow paths have rusted through. Mine and smelt six Iron Bars for replacements, and bring me four Coal Lumps for the work. I would like the next funeral procession to arrive with the same number of people it set out with.
quests.lesson: Mining and smelting stay independent of professions.

quests.title: A Flame Worth Keeping
quests.text: Bring me three Wisp Motes from the Wandering Wisps that appear in the {name:wispfen} after dark. I need them for the vigil candles. When the last visitor leaves, I like there to be a little light left behind.
quests.lesson: A night drop request that shares the wisp outing.

quests.title: A Place in the Book
quests.text: The Pauper Shamblers rise at night across the {name:gravemoor} {dir_of:mournfen_village:gravemoor}, with no one left to claim them. Lay six to rest. I shall enter each in the burial book, though I have only numbers to give them. A number is a poor memorial, but a blank page is worse.
quests.lesson: A night hunt near the top of the band; the Shamblers walk among the Grave Gnawers.

quests.title: Arrows Over the Evidence
quests.text: The trail of stolen barrow goods ends at the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, where the Bandit Lookouts discourage inquiries with arrows. Close the distance and kill six. They are holding Hollis Grey there; I need his account of things, preferably before it requires a medium.
quests.lesson: Ranged humanoids: close the distance or use cover.

quests.title: The Witness Is Still Talking
quests.text: With fewer lookouts, you have a chance to reach Hollis Grey in the {name:bandit_camp}. Go and speak with him; he has spent weeks watching the bandits carry sacks away. Captivity gives a man time to notice things, particularly when he no longer needs to sleep.
quests.lesson: Travel to a captive inside a hostile camp.

quests.title: Strike Out the Counter
quests.text: I counted every sack they carried to the {name:mire_nests} {dir_from_giver:mire_nests}; there was precious little else to do from a cage. {name:reed_counter_silt} counts the bones there and pays the bandits in pearls. Kill five Reed Mirefolk at the nests and the Reed-Counter as well, then take word to Sera Vane at the outpost. I would dearly like my last memory of this place to be of their accounts failing to add up.
quests.lesson: The line's climax: a named normal leader at its camp.

quests.title: Names Missing From the Register
quests.text: Hollis is out of that cage, and the Reed-Counter's tally is closed for good. Go to Nhal Veyr and tell Ossa Quietregister in the Vigil Hall what the mirefolk were buying; the capital's register has gaps where our dead should be, and someone must account for them.

quests.title: Bounty: The Graves Need Minding
quests.text: Each night the Grave Gnawers burrow into the {name:barrowfields}, undoing another day's careful burial work. Kill six and return to me. You may take this task again twenty minutes after handing it in; eternal rest has proved surprisingly demanding to maintain.

quests.title: Bounty: Six Fewer False Lights
quests.text: Wandering Wisps are gathering over the {name:deepfen}, which lies {zone_area:deepfen}, after dark, and I have no wish to drag another hopeful traveller out of the reeds. Put out six and report to me. The watch offers this task again twenty-five minutes after you hand it in; until then, distrust anything that glows and beckons.
quests.lesson: Optional repeatable hunting contract at the top of the band.
